model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the sensitivity associated with different block indices. The horizontal axis represents the "Block Index" in sequential order, with specific tick marks labeled at indices 0, 11, 23, 35, and 47. The vertical axis measures "Sensitivity" on a logarithmic scale, featuring major labeled tick marks and corresponding dashed horizontal gridlines at $10^{-5}$ and $10^{-4}$, alongside standard minor logarithmic tick marks. The chart displays a sequence of 48 individual vertical bars, one for each block index from 0 to 47. According to the legend in the upper left corner, the colors of the bars denote two different categories: blue bars represent "4-Fbit" and green bars represent "2-Fbit." The bars are not grouped or stacked; instead, a single uniquely colored bar is plotted for each block index. The plotted sensitivity values vary across the sequence, with the shortest bar located near block index 4 at an approximate value of $3 \times 10^{-6}$, and the tallest bar located near block index 46, reaching approximately $3 \times 10^{-4}$. The lower block indices, extending from 0 up to 28, are entirely composed of green "2-Fbit" bars, whereas the higher block indices feature a mixture of green and predominantly blue "4-Fbit" bars. The bars are sorted sequentially from left to right by their block index, and there are no specifically outlined, bolded, or explicitly annotated bars outside of the color-coded legend designation.
model_annotations.German: The bar chart illustrates the sensitivity across sequential block indices for two different configurations, designated as 4-Fbit and 2-Fbit. The horizontal axis represents the "Block Index," arranged sequentially from left to right with numerical tick labels displayed at 0, 11, 23, 35, and 47. The vertical axis represents "Sensitivity" using a logarithmic scale, featuring major tick labels at 10⁻⁵ and 10⁻⁴, with minor tick marks indicating the log scale intervals spanning an approximate value range from 3 × 10⁻⁶ to 4 × 10⁻⁴. Horizontal dashed grid lines span the width of the chart, aligning with the major vertical tick marks. The chart displays a single vertical bar for each block index up to 47. The color of each bar denotes its category based on the inset legend in the upper left: blue indicates "4-Fbit" and green indicates "2-Fbit." The bars are not stacked or grouped side-by-side per index; instead, each index possesses exactly one bar colored according to its category. Green bars appear continuously from index 0 to 28, and intermittently at indices 32, 37, and 40. Blue bars populate the remaining positions, specifically at indices 29 through 31, 33 through 36, 38 through 39, and 41 through 47. The shortest bar is a green bar located near index 4, corresponding to a sensitivity value of approximately 3 × 10⁻⁶. The tallest bar is a blue bar located at index 46, reaching a sensitivity value of approximately 3 × 10⁻⁴. The bars are sorted in ascending numerical order by their block index, and no specific bars are visually emphasized through bolding, outlining, or individual annotation beyond their categorical color assignment.
